title: Distillation for Incrimination and Distillation for Capabilities
abstract: arXiv:2610.11012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Powerful misaligned AI models might recognize alignment evaluations and strategically behave well on them, rendering direct audits uninformative. However, distilling such a model into a weaker benign student places the teacher in a Distillation Double Bind: if misalignment transfers, the student may conceal it less effectively, revealing evidence about the teacher; if it does not, the student may learn useful capabilities while remaining benign. We introduce two distinct distillation approaches, one targeting each outcome. Distillation for Incrimination (DFI) aims to transfer misalignment but not the ability to conceal it. Distilling AuditBench's secret-keeping models into their underlying instruction-tuned model produces students that are significantly more likely than their teachers to admit their hidden behavior when asked, suggesting that knowledge of the behavior transferred more readily than the propensity to conceal it. translated_title: 用于揭露罪证的蒸馏与用于获取能力的蒸馏
translated_abstract: 强大的失对齐AI模型可能会识别出对齐评估并在其中策略性地表现良好，从而使直接审计失去参考价值。然而，将这样一个模型蒸馏到一个较弱的良性学生模型中，会使教师模型陷入“蒸馏双难困境”：如果失对齐性发生转移，学生模型可能无法有效地隐藏它，从而揭示关于教师模型的证据；如果没有转移，学生模型则可能在保持良性的同时学到有用的能力。我们提出了两种不同的蒸馏方法，分别对应这两种结果。用于揭露罪证的蒸馏旨在转移失对齐性但不转移隐藏它的能力。将AuditBench的秘密保守模型蒸馏到其底层指令微调模型中，得到的学生模型在被询问时明显比其教师模型更倾向于承认自己的隐藏行为，这表明失对齐行为的知识比隐藏行为的倾向更容易发生转移。
tldr: 论文提出蒸馏会让失对齐的教师模型陷入“双难困境”，并设计了“取证蒸馏”方法，实验证明失对齐行为的知识比隐藏该行为的能力更容易传递给学生模型，因此蒸馏可用于审计并揭露教师模型的隐藏失对齐行为。
en_tdlr: Distillation places misaligned teacher models in a double bind; the proposed Distillation for Incrimination (DFI) demonstrates that knowledge of misaligned behavior transfers to weaker students more readily than the ability to conceal it, enabling audits to expose the teacher's hidden misalignment.
